question: Of the corn straw fuel and the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel, which had the higher maximum weight loss rate at 30 °C/min, and what higher heating value does that fuel have?
rendered:
Based on the document, at 30 °C/min, the corn straw fuel (SF) had a maximum weight loss rate of 5.55 ± 0.24 %/min and the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel (CF) had a maximum weight loss rate of 13.79 ± 0.65 %/min. Therefore, CF had a higher maximum weight loss rate.

The document does not mention the higher heating value of the fuels.
